name: CSN 3102 轮挡 左发防冰失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at gate 211, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从北京飞往广州，在 211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, gate211, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, runway 19R, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，跑道 19R，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, runway 19right, QNH 1014, CSN3102.

cards.audioText: B: You have completed push back and start up, but the chocks are still in position, inform the controller of the situation and ask ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车，但轮挡仍在位，告知管制员情况并请求地面保障移除轮挡。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, the chocks are still in position, request ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，轮挡仍在位，请求地面保障移除轮挡。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系北京机坪。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi to holding point runway 19R via taxiway Zulu 18, Mike 5, hold short of Foxtrot.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 18、Mike 5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，Foxtrot 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z18、M5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，F 外等待，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of taxiway Foxtrot, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Foxtrot 滑行道外等待，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN3102, holding short of taxiway F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN3102，在 F 滑行道外等待。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, hold short of Foxtrot, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，Foxtrot 外等待，联系北京地面121.95。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, you find there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, contact Beijing Ground and tell the controller you want to have the ice and snow removed before takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，你发现机翼上有冰雪，联系北京地面并告诉管制员你想在起飞前除冰雪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3102, there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, de-ice on taxiway Zulu 4.
B: Tell Beijing Ground the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and your slot time is 35.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，在滑行道 Zulu 4 除冰。
B：告诉北京地面除冰液只有效 30 分钟，你的时隙是 35。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3102, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and our slot time 35.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN3102，除冰液只有效 30 分钟，我们的时隙是 35。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4 and Foxtrot to holding point runway 19R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经滑行道 Zulu 4 和 Foxtrot 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4 and F to holding point runway 19R, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 F 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 600 meters, make initial contact with Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，与北京离场首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, Beijing Departure, radar contact, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，北京离场，雷达识别，QNH 1014 爬升至 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014, CSN3102.

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 1800 meters, you are encountering severe icing, tell the controller you want a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 1800 米，正在遭遇严重结冰，告诉管制员你想要更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, maintaining 1800 meters, we are encountering severe icing, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，保持 1800 米，我们正在遭遇严重结冰，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, negative due traffic, maintain 1800 meters until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，因交通不能同意，保持 1800 米直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 1800 meters until advised, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 1800 米直到通知，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now the icing condition is deteriorating, your left engine anti-ice has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在结冰情况恶化，你的左发防冰失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求更高高度离开结冰区。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CSN3102, the icing condition is deteriorating, our left engine anti-ice has failed, request a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，CSN3102，结冰情况正在恶化，我们左发防冰失效，请求更高高度离开结冰区。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, roger PAN PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，收到 PANPAN，爬升并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, CSN3102.

cards.audioText: B: Now you have left icing area, tell the controller that you have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离开结冰区，告诉管制员你在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3102, we have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN3102，我们在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1014.
B: You confirm with Beijing Departure if you should descend to 900 meters because it is below the minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，QNH 1014 下降至 900 米。
B：你向北京离场确认是否应下降至 900 米，因为这低于最低安全高度。
cards.referenceText: Confirm descend to 900 meters, it is below the minimum safe altitude, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 确认下降至 900 米，这低于最低安全高度，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, my apologies, cancel speed restrictions, recleared to descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，抱歉，取消速度限制，重新许可 QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel speed restrictions, descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米，CSN3102。
